fields.Front: What is the CS3319A grade breakdown, and what must you get to pass?
fields.Back:
1. Assignments (3) 24% - 6% each submission + 2% each peer review, on Kritik
2. Quizzes (5) 15%
3. Flipped classroom sessions (5) 20% - 1% attendance + 3% for at least 50% on the group worksheet
4. Final exam 41%
To pass: at least 30% on the final exam AND at least 60% overall, plus the VM setup check.

fields.Front: What Week 1-2 deliverables and dates should you have in your calendar?
fields.Back:
Quiz 1 (Weeks 1-2): available Sep 20, due Sep 21, 11:59 pm - do it before the first flipped session.
Flipped Classroom Session 1: Tue Sep 22.
Assignment 1 (ER modelling and relational schema design): available Sep 15, due Oct 4, peer review due Oct 25.
Assignments have a 48-hour no-penalty grace period; the first missed quiz moves to the final.

fields.Front: What are the prerequisites and the delivery format of CS3319A?
fields.Back: Prerequisites: CS 2210A/B and CS 2211A/B. Blended / flipped classroom: recorded lectures posted on OWL, in-person flipped sessions in MC-110 on selected Tuesdays 10:30 am-12:30 pm; Friday 12:30-1:30 pm is office hours only (MC384, Zoom sign-up).

fields.Text: The textbook is {{c1::Elmasri and Navathe, Fundamentals of Database Systems, 7th ed.}}; the recorded lectures and slides were prepared by {{c1::Laura Reid}}; the coordinator is {{c1::Dr. Mostafa Milani}}; email must carry the subject prefix [CS 3319].
